Name: Rechab
Summary: Ancestor of the house of Rechab, named among the scribes' families at Jabez.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:55: Ancestor of the house of Rechab, named among the scribes' families at Jabez.
